notes: Fiscal year ended 31 March 2026 (Infosys 'fiscal 2026'). CURRENCY: the IFRS consolidated statements in the Form 20-F (accession 0001193125-26-270520, filed June 15, 2026, read on sec.gov) are presented in US dollars, so cash, workers and geography are in USD. The Indian Integrated Annual Report 2025-26 (Ind AS, INR) is used only for ownership; it was fetched from infosys.com with browser-like request headers (plain scripted requests get HTTP 403). OWNERSHIP comes from the annual report because the 20-F's Item 7 table lists only Life Insurance Corporation of India (10.81% at May 20, 2026) and directors and officers as a group (2.53%), and Murthy is not a director or officer. Murthy is listed individually as a promoter with 1,51,45,638 shares (15,145,638), 0.37% of 405,55,91,723 shares at 31 March 2026; his share count is unchanged and the percentage rose because Infosys bought back 10 crore shares in fiscal 2026. FAMILY: the 13.30% 'Promoters and Promoter Group' figure is the disclosed total for all of Infosys's co-founder promoters and their families (Murthy, Nilekani, Gopalakrishnan, Shibulal and Dinesh families). It includes Murthy's own 0.37% and is not Murthy's family alone. Members of his family are listed individually (Rohan Murty 1.50%, Akshata Murty 0.96%, Sudha N. Murty 0.85%, Ekagrah Rohan Murty 0.04%), but no total for them is given, so none is recorded. The report also describes requests by some Shibulal family members to be reclassified from the promoter group to the public category. HOLDERS: from the annual report's list of non-promoter, non-ADR holders above 1% (PAN-based) at 31 March 2026. LIC is India's state-owned life insurer, typed 'other' because it invests policyholder funds. ADR holders (7.52% as a category, held by the depositary) are not a beneficial owner and are excluded. BUYBACKS: $2,006 million for the tender-offer buyback of 100,000,000 shares (about 2.41% of equity) at up to ₹1,800 per share approved by shareholders in November 2025; the label says it includes transaction costs. DIVIDENDS exclude dividends to non-controlling interests (nil in fiscal 2026). STOCK COMP: $108 million. Grants are made under the 2015 and 2019 plans to eligible employees and are performance-based, so no broad-based employee plan is recorded. The 20-F's new-year XBRL facts are not in companyfacts, so no xbrl objects are given.
